verdict.rationale: Whisper's code is published in a public first-party GitHub repository (openai/whisper), with an installable package, README and model card served from it, and a Python API exposing lower-level model access. A community comment implicitly groups Whisper with open-source models, but no evidence names the actual license or its terms. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., the LICENSE file or the license name), documentation of license terms, independent confirmation of the source license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: You can download and install (or update to) the latest release of Whisper with the following command: pip install -U openai-whisper
`whisper.detect_language()` and `whisper.decode()` which provide lower-level access to the model.
Whisper didn't strike them as particularly better than other open-source or built-in models.
